# ==============================================================================
# oe_nav2.15 — Enlightenment Survey: Dual-Branch Royal Academy Charter (Stalled at Launch)
# ==============================================================================
oe_nav2.15 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_nav2.15.t
	desc = oe_nav2.15.d
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_nav2_enlightenment_survey.dds"

	# Branch A: Mediterranean-Near East Classical Archaeology & Epigraphy
	option = {
		name = oe_nav2.15.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_nav2.15.a.tt
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:expedition }
			scope:expedition = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_survey_branch value = 1 }
				clear_expedition_waypoints = yes
				add_new_waypoint = location:rome
				add_new_waypoint = location:naples
				add_new_waypoint = location:athens
				add_new_waypoint = location:corinth
				add_new_waypoint = location:mystras
				add_new_waypoint = location:smyrna
				add_new_waypoint = location:bergama
				add_new_waypoint = location:alexandria
				add_new_waypoint = location:qena
				add_new_waypoint = location:aswan
				add_new_waypoint = location:tadmur
				add_new_waypoint = location:hillah
				add_new_waypoint = location:istakhr
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_nav2_home_loc }
					add_new_waypoint = var:oe_nav2_home_loc
				}
				else = {
					add_new_waypoint = root.capital
				}
			}
			resume_expedition = scope:expedition
		}
	}

	# Branch B: Global Equatorial Meridian & Transit of Venus Expedition (via Guayaquil port -> Quito)
	option = {
		name = oe_nav2.15.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_nav2.15.b.tt
		location:good_hope_cape = { discover_location = root }
		location:guayaquil = { discover_location = root }
		location:quito = { discover_location = root }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:expedition }
			scope:expedition = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_nav2_survey_branch value = 2 }
				clear_expedition_waypoints = yes
				add_new_waypoint = location:good_hope_cape
				add_new_waypoint = location:guayaquil
				add_new_waypoint = location:quito
				add_new_waypoint = location:guayaquil
				add_new_waypoint = location:alexandria
				add_new_waypoint = location:athens
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = oe_nav2_home_loc }
					add_new_waypoint = var:oe_nav2_home_loc
				}
				else = {
					add_new_waypoint = root.capital
				}
			}
			resume_expedition = scope:expedition
		}
	}
}
